subject.title: Feature Request: Add premium request % to /usage footer

question: Should `/usage` reply footers render provider quota windows from a lifecycle-owned cached snapshot, and if so should that apply to `tokens`, `full`, or only one mode?
rationale: The feature is viable with existing generic provider-usage data, but putting provider loading on a per-reply hot path would set a lasting latency, freshness, and failure-policy contract that source inspection alone cannot choose.

options.title: Cached snapshot for `/usage full`
options.body: Render a compact generic quota summary only from a lifecycle-owned cached snapshot when `/usage full` is enabled, preserving a reply hot path with no provider fetch.

options.title: Support both usage modes
options.body: Expose the same cached quota summary for both `tokens` and `full`, accepting a broader user-visible footer contract.

options.title: Keep quota status in `/status`
options.body: Decline per-response quota rendering and retain `/status` as the explicit on-demand provider-usage surface.

recommendation.title: Cached snapshot for `/usage full`
recommendation.body: Render a compact generic quota summary only from a lifecycle-owned cached snapshot when `/usage full` is enabled, preserving a reply hot path with no provider fetch.

likelyOwner.reason: Their provider-usage/status work and supplied maintainer comment most directly cover the cache and lifecycle boundary.
